2026 Toyota Glanza facelift walkaround: Toyota has updated the Glanza with a new 3-cylinder engine, Level 2 ADAS and ventilated front seats. We take a closer look at what’s changed and whether it’s worth picking over the Maruti Baleno.
The design changes are subtle. Up front, the Glanza gets a larger grille with satin trims, redesigned LED fog lamps and a repositioned Toyota logo, while a radar module sits behind the fascia for the ADAS. A shark-fin antenna joins the list, along with two new colours, Digital Teal Green and Bluish Black. The rear stays as it was.
